split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate commits; positions 1 and 2 are normative, position 3 is determinative
split_justification.reason: Position 1 changes runtime behaviour that everything else in this block rests on, and it is complete and green on its own against the full test suite and the offline-final phase of the block that currently declares checks over these paths. Position 2 adds the owner facing tool and the block's own manifest, which can only be green once that manifest exists and every phase it declares has run against it — the condition sharpened in B0c.
condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates
the full tooling test suite passes
the configuration loader binding check passes
every phase declared for the changed subject has run against the new scope (R5)
a commit that introduces or changes a block manifest is green only when every phase that manifest declares has run against it
split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.

guard_package_affected.reason: The runtime package gains tools/guard/observed.py and changes owner_exception.py, decide.py, entry.py and rules.json, so the package content and its digest change. The guard version moves to the next candidate.
guard_package_affected.activation_point: after the normative commits and after preflight, targeted and offline-final have passed against the candidate; platform-live and module-final follow the activation
